notes: Plan with AI eval (QA round 4). Each case is one prompt to the planner, run over the places snapshot with the no-model fallback and two stand-in models that ignore the request (one takes the first candidates, one the priciest), so the rules must hold whatever the model returns. budgetPerHead: entry costs plus the meal estimate must fit. cities: every stop's city must be one of these, unless a plan note names the stop. minStops / minMinutes: the plan must be at least this full. meals: meal kinds that need a stop (or a note saying why there is none). indoor: every stop must be marked indoor in its own data. required: slugs that must be stops (or named in a note).
